title: cicd.toml Configuration Schema
description: Contract for cicd.toml — the carrier configuration for cargo-cicd. Unknown fields are rejected (deny_unknown_fields). Consumers MUST read the exact keys below.

name.description: Workspace or package name. Must be non-empty.

toolchain.description: Rust toolchain channel: stable, beta, nightly, or a version string starting with a digit (e.g. 1.86.0).

target_dir.description: Relative path to the Cargo target directory.

dirty.description: Whether the working tree has uncommitted changes.

target_size_gb.description: Current size of the Cargo target directory in gigabytes.

changed_files.description: Number of changed source files since the base ref.

changed_tests.description: Number of changed test files since the base ref.

changed_trybuild_fixtures.description: Number of changed trybuild fixture files since the base ref.

max_size_gb.description: Maximum allowed size of the Cargo target directory in gigabytes. Must be > 0.

prune_after_days.description: Number of days after which target artifacts are pruned.

enabled.description: Whether to run only changed tests.

base.description: Git ref used as the base for detecting changed tests. Must be non-empty.

enabled.description: Whether to run only changed trybuild fixtures.

snapshot_mode.description: Snapshot mode for trybuild: changed-only or all.

require_clean_tree.description: Whether the working tree must be clean before each phase.

commit_after_phase.description: Whether to auto-commit after each phase completes.

mode.description: Autonomic mode: suggest (recommendations only), apply (auto-fix), or report (log only).

events.description: Event log records appended by the pipeline. Optional.

standing.description: Standing compiler configuration (cargo cicd standing ...). Optional; a cicd.toml without this section still parses.

doctor_command.description: Shell command printing doctor check --format json shaped output: {build, config, frontier, receipts, tools, features}.

ocel_logs.description: Glob patterns for OCEL process-validation JSON logs.

process_validation.description: Glob patterns for OCEL process-validation JSON ({is_conforming, fitness, violations, ...}).

receipt_ledgers.description: Paths to JSONL receipt ledgers, one record per line, each carrying chain_hash_hex.

plan_runs_glob.description: Glob for plan.json plan-run artifacts carrying powl_chain_hash.

bench_raw_glob.description: Glob for raw benchmark output files (existence/size/hash only).

claim_tables.description: Paths to markdown claim-promotion tables. Informational only, never authoritative standing.

clients.description: Client build targets built and BUILDS-evidenced during standing refresh.

release_docs_dir.description: Directory of release docs consulted by the claude-context verb.

release_gates.description: Map of release_id -> required [artifact_id, status] pairs, checked by gate release.
